stops.name: Munot Fortress
stops.quote: One particular highlight is the Munot Fortress.
stops.english: One particular highlight is the Munot Fortress.

stops.name: Rhine Falls
stops.quote: The Rhine Falls are around ten minutes away from Schaffhausen.
stops.english: The Rhine Falls are around ten minutes away from Schaffhausen.

stops.name: Haus zum Ritter
stops.quote: Marvel at historic buildings such as the Haus zum Ritter and make a stop at Herrenacker: the largest square in the old town is surrounded by restaurants and cafés, making it an ideal place to take a break.
stops.english: Marvel at historic buildings such as the Haus zum Ritter and make a stop at Herrenacker: the largest square in the old town is surrounded by restaurants and cafés, making it an ideal place to take a break.

stops.name: Museum zu Allerheiligen
stops.quote: From here, visit the Museum zu Allerheiligen.
stops.english: From here, visit the Museum zu Allerheiligen.

stops.name: Fronwagplatz
stops.quote: Or continue to roam through the city’s alleyways and take a break at one of the fountains on Fronwagplatz.
stops.english: Or continue to roam through the city’s alleyways and take a break at one of the fountains on Fronwagplatz.

stops.name: Lindli Promenade
stops.quote: Bring the day to a close with a stroll along the Lindli Promenade, a picturesque path right by the River Rhine.
stops.english: Bring the day to a close with a stroll along the Lindli Promenade, a picturesque path right by the River Rhine.

stops.name: Stein am Rhein
stops.quote: The small town of Stein am Rhein is also well worth visiting.
stops.english: The small town of Stein am Rhein is also well worth visiting.

stops.name: Thurauen Nature Centre
stops.quote: The Thurauen Nature Centre is a popular excursion destination.
stops.english: The Thurauen Nature Centre is a popular excursion destination.

stops.name: Hallau
stops.quote: In villages such as Hallau or Wilchingen, you’ll get an insight into the cultivation of Pinot Noir.
stops.english: In villages such as Hallau or Wilchingen, you’ll get an insight into the cultivation of Pinot Noir.
